This draft needs confirmed business contacts and operating details, plus legal review, before public launch or customer onboarding.

What cookies are

Cookies are small pieces of information a website stores in your browser. Similar technologies include local storage and other identifiers. Some support essential features; others are used for analytics, personalisation or advertising.

What this website uses

Sena’s page code currently does not set cookies, use local storage or include optional analytics or advertising scripts. Room filters, billing selection and booking previews use temporary page memory and reset when you reload. Fonts and page images are served with the website rather than embedded from a third-party font or advertising service.

This private site is hosted behind provider-managed access controls. The hosting or access provider may use essential session and security technologies outside Sena’s page code. Their exact names, purposes and durations need to be recorded before this policy is finalised for public launch.

Optional technologies and consent

No optional tracking is included in Sena’s current page code, so this edition does not present an unnecessary “accept all” banner. If optional tracking is added, this policy and the relevant consent controls must be updated before those tools are activated where consent is required. Declining optional tracking should remain as straightforward as accepting it.

Your browser choices

You can inspect, block or remove cookies using your browser’s privacy settings. Blocking essential session technologies may prevent access to a private preview or signed-in service. Changing browser settings does not delete information already held by a hosting provider.

More information

See our Privacy policy for the scope of this preview and personal information rights. The provider cookie inventory and Sena’s public privacy contact are awaiting confirmation before public launch.
